第二十三章小黑的实力
陈林回到地狱犬领地中的山洞后，感觉到里面的小黑气势不断的在加强着，就知道小黑已经度过了最艰难的时刻，现在就看小黑自己能得到多少好处了……
陈林进入偏殿后，就感觉小黑现在控制的毁灭之力更加的恐怖了，现在这种能量给陈林的感觉比八阶巅峰的小三还要强，而现在小黑的实力只是提升到七阶巅峰。
陈林在感觉到小黑的变化后自言自语道“看来这次小黑得到的正真好处，并不是实力上的提升，而是他控制的毁灭之力更加纯净危险了。”
真不知道小黑生前到底有多强，而且陈林对小黑背后的那个神秘人更是好奇！要知道小黑背后的那个神秘人的实力，即使现在的陈林都没能看破。
小黑之所以没能成为陈林的狂信徒，就是因为哪个神秘才在小黑灵魂深处有不可磨灭的地位。就连禁魂咒这样的神通也不能改变他在小黑心中的地位，想想小黑的实力就知道这个神秘人的实力有多么变态了！
不过陈林心里没有太多的怨言，毕竟小黑是神秘人托付给自己的。而且小黑给陈林的感觉就好像是朋友一样，自己让一次在神秘空间修炼，小黑保护自己不予余力！看来是神秘人对小黑的前世很重要，以至于一直影响着小黑。
不过陈林的实力越是提高，就对小黑和神秘人的实力和身份越感到好奇，以现在的情况来看，小黑和神秘人应该是被困在了亡灵界。那么对方的实力岂不是不小黑生前还要强。想到这里陈林顿时对异界圣阶以后实力产生了兴趣，也不知道自己神魂决能让自己站在异界的什么样的巅峰位置。
不过这些对现在的陈林来说太远了，毕竟现在陈林还只是一个小亡灵，实力也只是刚刚突破到八阶初级，这是至此清剿周围势力的到得最直接的好处。
在陈林胡思乱想的这一会功夫，小黑的实力已经超越了陈林到达了八阶中级。陈林看着小黑的实力还是不断的在增长，陈林打心里高兴毕竟这都是自己的间接实力。
在陈林不断的等待中小黑终于炼化了自己的武器，小黑的实力也定格在了九阶初级。现在的小黑已经不在是一个骷髅的样子了，经过两个阶位的提升，现在小黑已经拥有了完整的躯体，而且还在自己周身形成能量铠甲！
现在的小黑全身上下都被一层漆黑色的盔甲包裹着，这身铠甲看起来十分的平淡上面没有一点纹路修饰，但是给人的感觉却是十分的霸气，仿佛是地狱中的战神一般！
而且小黑手中拿着一柄大刀，刀身长度适中上面不断有强烈的能量流动，而且在到身上拥有强大的杀戮之气！只不过这柄刀已经残破，刀尖部分已经丢失！这个结果让陈林又是一阵感慨，一柄破损的大刀就有这么强大的能量！
陈林感觉自己现在的小心脏已经被小黑打击的越来越坚强了。陈林在小黑清醒过来时，就上去和小黑打趣道，“现在怎么你们一个比一个变态，让我这个主人情何以堪啊！”
不过小黑的实力提升，也让陈林再次拥有了一张王牌。于是在小黑短暂的巩固实力后，陈林又开始出动了。这一次的目标很明确，就是周围剩下来的势力，七阶高级的僵尸莫哥和八阶初级亡灵骑士索尔。
这两个势力莫哥是因为与世无争和地形的原因，从不和其它势力有任何的摩擦！而索尔是因为中间有地形和势力的阻隔，让索尔的势力没有机会接触。
在确定后，陈林带领这全部的高级手下前去，现在陈林手下的高级亡灵已经有近五百多个，其中有地狱犬一百二十多只，杰斯利原先的手下二百多名，还有哈莱姆的手下一百五十多名！其它的就是陈林的老部下了。除了这些外，陈还带领着小三和他的三个手下，五个八阶以上的高手，还有就是已经九阶的小黑。
在陈林手下六个八阶高手的带领下，只用了很短的功夫就收收拾了莫哥这个僵尸群。让陈林意外的是莫哥带领的这群僵尸，十分的顽强在陈林带领的这么多强大的亡灵面前，他竟然宁死不屈直到战死也没有投降！而且他的手下也是这样，直到几乎所有的智慧僵尸都杀完了，其它的僵尸才开始放弃反抗。
这个结果让陈林很意外，原本陈林还像收服莫哥这股力量，不过最终只是收服了寥寥几十只僵尸。看来并不是所有的亡灵生物都会屈服于武力的。
因为莫哥的整体实力太差，小黑根本没有机会施展自己刚刚提升的实力。于是在进入索尔的领地后，小黑就直接请命到前面当开路先锋去了。

不过再进入索尔的领地后，对方仿佛是知道自己要来一般，竟然遭到了对方的亡灵骑士队伍的偷袭！幸亏小黑施展出已经达到九阶的实力，直接开启了伪领域震慑住这些亡灵骑士，不然陈林的队伍肯定会损失不少。
要知道亡灵骑士单个的实力只能算是中等，但是只要以成群就会拥有冲击十倍以上对手的实力。毕竟在令兵器时代，骑兵的冲击能力是显而易见的。在亡灵界也是一样，很多亡灵势力都被成群的亡灵骑士以少胜多，最后落得惨败。
在躲过了这次偷袭后，这个叫索尔的亡灵骑士，竟然带领这自己的骑士队伍直接逃跑了。就连自己的其它手下都丢下了，看来是被小黑的伪领域给吓怕了。不过在陈林和手下的几名八阶以上的‘高手’，不断的追击下这个索尔还是只能老老实实的被收服，从此陈林手下终于有了一对骑兵，陈林将这队亡灵骑士叫做小二尔骑士团。
其实陈林自己也被小黑的伪领域给镇住了，小黑现在的伪领域力量已经超过了陈林。要知道陈林经过自己的不断对比，陈林知道了自己的伪领域力量已经达到了九阶巅峰的状态，只要陈林突破到识魂阶就能突破圣阶，拥有正真的领域力量。
而导致小黑伪领域这么强的原因，就是小黑使用的毁灭之力！在成为七阶以前，小黑的毁灭之力还并没什么只是比其他的能量强一点。可是现在小黑的毁灭之力，直接让他的伪领域超越了九阶巅峰的陈林。
陈林被震惊到后喃喃道“看来小黑的实力并不止表面这些，他的毁灭之力绝对不简单……”

Chapter 23 Xiao Hei’s Strength
After Chen Lin returned to the cave in the Cerberus territory, he felt that Xiao Hei's momentum inside was constantly strengthening. He knew that Xiao Hei had passed the most difficult moment. Now it was up to him to see how much benefit he could get...
After Chen Lin entered the side hall, he felt that the power of destruction now controlled by Xiao Hei was even more terrifying. This kind of energy now gave Chen Lin a feeling that it was stronger than Xiao San at the peak of the eighth level, and now Xiao Hei's strength had only been upgraded to the peak of the seventh level.
After feeling the changes in Xiao Hei, Chen Lin said to himself, "It seems that the real benefit Xiao Hei got this time is not an improvement in strength, but that the power of destruction he controls has become more pure and dangerous."
I really don’t know how strong Xiao Hei was during his lifetime, and Chen Lin is even more curious about the mysterious person behind Xiao Hei! To know the strength of the mysterious man behind Xiao Hei, even Chen Lin now can't see through it.
The reason why Xiao Hei failed to become Chen Lin's fanatical believer was because of the mystery that had an indelible status in the depths of Xiao Hei's soul. Even magical powers such as the soul-forbidden curse can't change his status in Xiao Hei's heart. Thinking about Xiao Hei's strength, you will know how abnormal this mysterious man's strength is!
However, Chen Lin didn't have too many complaints in his heart. After all, Xiao Hei was entrusted to him by the mysterious man. Moreover, Xiao Hei felt like a friend to Chen Lin. He once allowed him to practice in a mysterious space, and Xiao Hei spared no effort to protect him! It seems that the mysterious person was very important to Xiao Hei's past life, so much so that he has always influenced Xiao Hei.
However, the more Chen Lin's strength improved, the more curious he became about the strength and identity of Xiao Hei and the mysterious man. Judging from the current situation, Xiao Hei and the mysterious man should be trapped in the world of the dead. Then the other party's strength is not even stronger than when Xiao Hei was alive. Thinking of this, Chen Lin suddenly became interested in the strength beyond the other world's holy level, and he didn't know what kind of pinnacle position his Divine Soul Art could put him in in the other world.
However, these are too far for Chen Lin now. After all, Chen Lin is still just a little undead, and his strength has only just broken through to the eighth level. This is the most direct benefit of wiping out the surrounding forces so far.
While Chen Lin was thinking wildly, Xiao Hei's strength had surpassed Chen Lin and reached the eighth-level intermediate level. Chen Lin saw that Xiao Hei's strength was still growing, and Chen Lin felt happy in his heart. After all, this was all his indirect strength.
As Chen Lin kept waiting, Xiao Hei finally refined his weapon, and Xiao Hei's strength was fixed at the ninth level. Now Xiao Hei no longer looks like a skeleton. After two levels of promotion, Xiao Hei now has a complete body, and he is also forming energy armor around himself!
Now, Xiao Hei's whole body is wrapped in a layer of jet black armor. This armor looks very plain and has no texture on it, but it feels very domineering, as if he is the god of war in hell!
Moreover, Xiao Hei holds a large knife in his hand. The blade is of medium length, with strong energy constantly flowing on it, and it has a strong killing aura in it! It's just that this knife is broken, and the tip of the knife has been lost! This result made Chen Lin sigh with emotion again. A broken sword has such powerful energy!
Chen Lin felt that his little heart had been hit harder and harder by Xiao Hei. When Xiao Hei came to his senses, Chen Lin went up and joked with Xiao Hei, "Why are you so perverted now? It makes me, the master, so embarrassed!"
However, Xiao Hei's improved strength also gave Chen Lin another trump card. So after Xiao Hei briefly consolidated his strength, Chen Lin began to take action again. The target this time is very clear, which is the remaining forces around them, the seventh-level senior zombie Mo Ge and the eighth-level junior undead knight Thor.
These two forces, Mo Ge, never competed with each other because of their indifference to the world and the terrain.Any friction with other forces! As for Sol, because there are terrain and force barriers in the middle, Sol's forces have no chance to come into contact.
After confirming, Chen Lin led all the senior subordinates there. Now there are nearly 500 senior undead under Chen Lin, including more than 120 hellhounds, more than 200 of Jessel's original subordinates, and more than 150 of Harlem's subordinates! The others are Chen Lin's old subordinates. In addition to these, Chen also led Xiao San and his three subordinates, five masters above the eighth level, and Xiao Hei, who was already at the ninth level.
Under the leadership of Chen Lin's six eighth-level masters, it only took a short time to clean up Brother Mo's zombie group. What surprised Chen Lin was that the group of zombies led by Brother Mo were very tenacious. In the face of so many powerful undead led by Chen Lin, he would rather die than surrender until he died in battle! And the same was true for his men. It wasn't until almost all the intelligent zombies were killed that the other zombies began to give up resistance.
This result surprised Chen Lin. Originally, Chen Lin wanted to conquer Brother Mo's power, but in the end he only conquered a few dozen zombies. It seems that not all undead creatures will succumb to force.
Because Brother Mo's overall strength was so poor, Xiao Hei had no chance to display his newly improved strength. So after entering Sol's territory, Xiao Hei directly asked for orders to be the pioneer.
However, after entering Thor's territory, the opponent seemed to know that he was coming, and was unexpectedly attacked by the opponent's team of undead knights! Fortunately, Xiao Hei displayed his ninth-level strength and directly opened the pseudo-realm to frighten these undead knights. Otherwise, Chen Lin's team would definitely suffer a lot.
You must know that the undead knight's individual strength can only be regarded as average, but as long as they are in groups, they will have the strength to impact opponents ten times more. After all, in the era of imperial weapons, the impact capability of cavalry was obvious. The same is true in the world of the undead. Many undead forces were defeated by groups of undead knights, and finally suffered a disastrous defeat.
After escaping the sneak attack, the undead knight named Thor actually led his team of knights to escape directly. Even his other subordinates left behind, seemingly frightened by Xiao Hei's pseudo-domain. However, under the constant pursuit of Chen Lin and several eighth-level and above 'masters', Sol could only be subdued. From then on, Chen Lin finally had a pair of cavalry under his command. Chen Lin called this group of undead knights the Little Er Knights.
In fact, Chen Lin himself was suppressed by Xiao Hei's pseudo domain. Xiao Hei's current pseudo domain power has surpassed Chen Lin. You must know that after Chen Lin's constant comparison, Chen Lin knew that his pseudo-domain power had reached the peak of the ninth level. As long as Chen Lin breaks through to the soul consciousness level, he can break through the holy level and possess true domain power.
The reason why Xiao Hei's pseudo-realm is so strong is the power of destruction used by Xiao Hei! Before reaching the seventh level, Xiao Hei's destructive power was nothing but a little stronger than other energies. But now Xiao Hei's destructive power has directly made his pseudo-domain surpass Chen Lin, who is at the peak of the ninth level.
Chen Lin was shocked and murmured, "It seems that Xiao Hei's strength is more than just superficial. His destructive power is definitely not simple..."
